title: Dashboard locale selection diverges from React translation state when localStorage is denied
classification: i18n/state consistency under restricted browser storage

source_to_sink.evidence: readDashboardLocale returns default en when localStorage.getItem throws. commitDashboardLocale swallows localStorage.setItem failure but still sets document lang/dir to the requested locale and dispatches the locale-change event.

useSyncExternalStore uses readDashboardLocale as its client snapshot; translation selection and direction derive from that snapshot. There is no in-memory fallback state. The change event therefore rechecks a store that still returns en when storage throws.
Startup also reads localStorage inside a catch-all block and supplies no independent persistent/in-memory locale authority when storage is denied.

preconditions: Dashboard JavaScript runs but localStorage get/set throws or is denied.
The user selects Arabic while the provider snapshot is the default English locale.
impact: The commit path can mark the document ar/rtl while React's locale snapshot and translated strings remain English. The user-visible locale preference therefore does not reliably take effect and document direction/language can disagree with rendered text until a storage-capable reload/state change.
counterevidence_and_bounds: Normal storage-capable paths are internally consistent and are exercised by existing E2E/component usage.
This is not an authorization or data-integrity bypass.
The exact behavior of a specific private/webview browser mode depends on whether that mode throws for localStorage; the finding is conditional on the explicit restricted-storage precondition.
existing_test_cross_check: Repository search found no Dashboard locale test that makes localStorage get/set throw. Existing Dashboard E2E locale changes write localStorage successfully then dispatch the custom event. Customer CUST-001/#356 already proves the same architectural failure class in the separate Customer implementation, but its recorded paths do not include Dashboard locale.ts/provider.tsx.
remediation_direction: Use an in-memory external-store snapshot/fallback so same-window locale commits update React state even when persistence fails, while keeping localStorage as best-effort persistence. Add a Dashboard-specific restricted-storage locale test and preserve current EN/AR DOM direction behavior/UI geometry.
regression_risks: Do not let the in-memory preference become an authorization or server-data source.
Keep cross-tab storage-event synchronization when storage is available.
Preserve SSR default/hydration behavior and current UI Freeze geometry.
duplicate_status: Related root-cause pattern to existing CUST-001/#356 but a distinct Dashboard code path and user surface. Prime should choose whether to extend the existing issue or register a Dashboard-specific finding; worker-7 created no GitHub issue.
